name: 헤이즈
visual_review: 회색 긴 머리·차가운 눈·케이스와 전술복을 유지했습니다. 케이스 꺼내기·휘두르기·런처 전개·발사 반동·접어 넣기의 실제 무기 동작을 확인했습니다.
motion_summary: Haze gray straight long hair covering part of face, red-gray eyes, black tactical coat and huge weapon case from portrait. R swings her weapon case then equips rocket launcher; illustrate transformation and one representative rocket attack. Animate idle with case on back; reaching back; pulling case forward; case sweeps in compact gray arc; locking case open into shoulder launcher; bracing feet with launcher shoulder-high and face visible above; fire orange-white muzzle flash and small red rocket right; recoil knees bending and hair shifting; spent smoke curls; lowering launcher; folding back to case; exact original idle. Real case/arm/torso changes, no generic magical orb.
